description: Get raw Reddit comments from the r/wallstreetbets daily discussion thread, top-level comments newest first. Returns one comment per line in a compact threaded format, with 2-space indentation for each reply level; a comment's own line breaks show as ' / '. A leading [↩N] means the comment has N replies so far (all levels), the only engagement signal: there are no vote counts, since the stored scores are snapshots from each comment's first minutes. Bot commands and short comments nobody replied to are filtered out. Useful for directly analyzing retail investor sentiment, popular tickers, and trading ideas.

date.description: Specific date to get comments for (format: YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for latest available discussion.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return (1-1500). Default: 500

name: get_wsb_discussion
